[[File:MammonHoole.jpg|thumb|250px|Mammon Hoole, a geneticist of the Republic]]
'''Geneticists''' were experts in genetics, a branch of [[xenobiology]] that dealt with the heredity and variation of organisms. They studied and manipulated [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] and [[Gene/Legends|genes]], typically working in [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratories]] and [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facilities. Some were formed at the [[Chandrilan Academy of Sciences]]. A notable example of genetic manipulation is that of the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]]. Contracted to create a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]], the Kaminoans used [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] as the [[Clone template/Legends|template]], creating an army that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] would later use in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After studying cloning processes, ambitious geneticists such as [[Borborygmus Gog]] and [[Mammon Hoole]] researched on abiogenesis, or spontaneous origination of living organisms from lifeless matter.
